items.title: Object authority is not aggregate matter authority
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: Object-only grants and a subset of operations cannot authorize whole-case access or another object; every requested operation must be checked against every consumed object.
items.product_implication: Keep aggregate projections explicit and require host object ownership/policy checks before any consumption.

history.reason: existing_task: B03-01 bounded object/operation service implemented; no production integration claim.

items.title: A stale WAL snapshot can retain revoked grants
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: An active SQLite read transaction can retain pre-revocation grants; obtaining a writer reservation before authority reads makes that stale snapshot fail closed.
items.product_implication: Do not let transaction-scoped authorization mean old snapshot authorization; accept contention denial rather than stale grant success.

history.reason: existing_task: B03-01 same-database writer reservation and stale-WAL regression adopted; PostgreSQL remains separate.

items.title: Two permitted principals still cannot exchange identity mid-transaction
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: Rechecking only that some current principal has grants can permit a transaction to begin as one actor and end as another equally permitted actor.
items.product_implication: Pin authenticated identity through the transaction so actor attribution survives reauthentication.

history.reason: existing_task: B03-01 stable-principal transaction and rollback tests adopted.

items.title: Login exchange and session publication have separate cancellation boundaries
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: A login attempt consumed before provider exchange still needs cancellation and expiry checks before publishing the returned identity session.
items.product_implication: Use one-use attempts, no uncertain exchange retry, and a post-exchange publication check; require a new explicit login after failure.

history.reason: existing_task: B03-01 durable attempt states and post-exchange cancellation/expiry tests adopted.

items.title: Local logout is not provider termination or matter authority withdrawal
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: Revoking a local opaque session neither terminates a provider account/session nor withdraws independently issued API tokens or future sign-ins.
items.product_implication: Keep local session, provider identity and current matter grants distinct in APIs and operator wording.

history.reason: decision_record: B03-01 logout response explicitly reports provider_session_ended=false; host must separately withdraw grants/account access.

items.title: Offline identity fixtures cannot establish production provider or MFA trust
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: Pinned signed-token fixtures exercise the local protocol but do not configure a real issuer, verify provider MFA/custody, establish distributed revocation or prove production row isolation.
items.product_implication: Retain explicit provider, production isolation and independent security gates even after local identity tests pass.

history.reason: existing_task: B03-01 production provider/MFA/PostgreSQL/key-custody/security-review acceptance remains external, not replaced by fixture results.

items.title: Expired unused login-attempt retention needs an explicit host policy
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: Unused expired login attempts can retain their verifier until an explicit cancellation or host retention action; this lane deliberately adds no background cleanup scan.
items.product_implication: Review an explicit protected-store retention and account/session administration policy before deployment rather than silently running maintenance.

history.reason: new_candidate: retain bounded host cleanup/admin review under B03-01 without adding a daemon, new required task or production acceptance claim.

items.title: Frozen shipping-state fixtures can fail truthful native evidence
items.origin: 2026-10-25 identity lane build and review; session d9478f50b2b844fcb292873f9d406d3d
items.observation: The partition changelog top entry is pushed_unreleased while native Studio hardcodes local unreleased; the builder cannot safely rewrite frozen shipping history or a shared test just to get green.
items.product_implication: Central integration must reconcile truthful shipping state and source-bound acceptance while preserving the failed experiment.

history.reason: decision_record: record failed Studio evidence and central reconciliation request; no shared test/history edit or native pass is claimed.
